messages:
margot: ok team, opening a low-effort, high-joy pet thread — meet Remy, my rescue pup. pic: https://i.imgur.com/RemyCute.jpg :dog: :heart_eyes:

 diego: oooo he has the side-eye down, absolute unit :dog: :flushed:

 luca: 10/10 ear flop. submit for the company calendar please :raised_hands: 

 jin: here's Mochi the cat loafing on my keyboard. she will not be moved. https://imgur.com/MochiLoaf.jpg :cat: :kissing_heart:

 nina: bunny cam!! my partner's bun does impressions of a sock puppet. pic: https://example.com/bunbun.png :rabbit: :laughing:

 margot: @jin @nina oh no the loaf vs the bunny vs the pup. Remy tried to sniff Mochi through the screen :joy:

 diego: pet-bot, decide. who wins cutest? :thinking_face:

 pet-bot: pet-bot: 🏆 Today's highly scientific result: Mochi the Loaf wins (remy gets runner-up and unlimited treats). :tada: :robot_face: 

 luca: can't believe the bot has opinions now. also — group dog walk next Friday? bring pets if you can :calendar: :dog:

 nina: count me in, tiny harness for the bunny incoming :sweat_smile:

 margot: added to #lunch-plans. Remy will bring treats and unsolicited cuddles :dog: :treat:

 jin: putting a few pics into the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/pets/2024-remy_mochi (plz add yours)

 diego: dropping heart reacts on all photos :heart_eyes: :heart:

 margot: thanks folks! see you Friday — may the snuggles be strong.
